title: thymus zygis var. tenuifolius
intro: Thymus zygis var. tenuifolius, commonly known as Spanish Thyme, is a plant species in the Lamiaceae family. It is used for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues. The plant is known for its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which provide health benefits such as wound healing, improved respiratory function, and protection against infections. The bioactive constituents of Spanish Thyme include thymol, carvacrol, and geraniol, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antiseptic, antibacterial, and antifungal effects.
